hypotheses.O0_basis_is_old_lexeme_discovery_only: The basis is fit only on original spelling cues in fold 0/split 0.
hypotheses.O1_rank1_raw_echo_generalizes_to_new_cue: Rank 1 captures at least 50% of raw H2 value-delta energy for entirely new cue lexemes in both splits.
hypotheses.O2_rank1_causal_echo_generalizes_to_new_: Rank 1 recovers at least 95% of the finite value-dependent H2 effect from new cues to old targets in both splits.
hypotheses.O3_rank1_generalizes_to_new_output_lexem: Rank 1 recovers at least 95% of the finite value-dependent H2 effect from old cues to new output targets in both splits.
hypotheses.O4_random_rank1_does_not_explain_the_eff: The best of eight random rank-1 subspaces remains below 25% causal fidelity in every case.
hypotheses.O5_routing_alone_remains_incomplete: Routing-only effect remains below half of the complete H2 post-boundary effect in every case.
